answer: Every claim opens on the Lotus board to a staking market: workers stake coins for or against it, and a lantern auditor checks it within two days. The filer locks 400 coins in a walnut chest; a fake claim forfeits the bond to its challengers and bars the filer a month. One worker risks 400 coins a claim, so 1,000 fakes need 400,000; one farm filing forty claims and backing its own fakes lost every bond when the auditor found the same hand twice.
